title: Hide or field-entry condition is a quoted constant
description:
Layout-quality rule — the hide-object condition or the field-entry condition of a layout object is a single quoted string literal. The formula was probably pasted together with its quotes; it evaluates as a constant instead of the intended calculation.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "ReportBrokenCalculationQuoted" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A formula pasted with surrounding quotes turns into a string constant. The hide or field-entry condition no longer reacts to record data — depending on the string it is constantly true or constantly false.
rule.remediation: Remove the surrounding quotes so the text becomes a real calculation again, and re-check the intended logic.
